title: Some Thoughts on the UFO Project
author: Robert J. Low

custody.runtimeCopy: Atlas-local derivatives of NICAP-hosted page scans recovered through the Internet Archive Wayback Machine
custody.boundary: Public archival-mirror custody; the scans are not presented as a University of Colorado originating-archive download.

supports: Robert Low wrote the memorandum before the Colorado project began its substantive case work.
The memorandum proposed presenting the project publicly as objective while signaling low expectations of finding a saucer to the scientific community.
The two recovered scans visually support the quoted wording and its continuation across pages 1 and 2.
limitations: The public scan chain is an archived NICAP mirror rather than direct originating-archive custody.
The memorandum documents proposed framing and expectations; it does not alone establish how every case was selected, analyzed, or written.
Institutional pre-judgment does not establish the identity or origin of any reported UAP.
